concept: Cognito identity pools: temporary credentials for mobile users
tests: Which service lets mobile app users sign in with Google and get temporary AWS access.
expected: Amazon Cognito Identity Pools federate external IdPs (Google, Facebook) and issue temporary credentials via IAM roles. Triggers: "mobile app users", "authenticate with Google", "temporary limited credentials".
why_not: Directory Service is managed AD; IAM users don't scale to app users; IAM Identity Center is workforce SSO, not consumer.
